ops.title: Generalized marketplace self-bootstrap shipped (9.22.0) + getaway one-line install
ops.body: capt-hook self-bootstrap generalized from hardcoded captain-hook to ANY consumer-declared dependency marketplace. A pack's capt-hook.toml gains marketplaces=["owner/repo",...]; pack attach registers each unknown one (captain-hook implicit) via 'claude plugin marketplace add', letting CC auto-resolve the plugin.json cross-marketplace deps. Phase 1 (manifest field + MARKETPLACE_REPO_RE validation in load, known-by-source.repo, argv-threaded variadic worker, dropped explicit plugin install) shipped in released 9.21.0 (commit 60b57a32). Two fable reviews (codex lane was down) found 8 correctness + 2 security items; all 10 fixed in 5ca4290b: #1 all-source known-detection (github source.repo + git url + basename-name fallback — killed an hourly re-add loop for git/local-source marketplaces), #2 per-repo error isolation (one failing repo no longer starves the rest), #3 non-blocking attach lock (no SessionStart stall on the worker), #4 per-(config-dir,repo) markers (cc-pool multi-config no longer cross-damps), #5 hot-path single read, #6 dedupe, #7 non-string→PackError, #8 attempt_fresh upper bound, #9 worker argv revalidation, #10 ASCII-anchored regex. Docs in c246abbd (plugin-packs 'Extra dependency marketplaces' section + generalized install/troubleshooting). Released 9.22.0 (c0277f55 plugin.json bump + tag v9.22.0; wheel-verified carries all fixes). getaway f1f91d6: capt-hook.toml marketplaces=["yasyf/cc-present"], README both install blocks → one '/plugin marketplace add yasyf/getaway' line, pack lint 7/7 green. Live multi-marketplace smoke: attach notice names yasyf/captain-hook + yasyf/cc-present, worker runs marketplace-add per repo, 2 per-repo markers, no plugin install. cc-present's own README still says add-captain-hook-first (obsolete since 9.15.0) = independent follow-up. Concurrent sessions burned 9.16-9.21 mid-work; Phase 1 rode a sibling's 9.21.0 tag.
